name: Gap Calculator
description: Select two objects in the editor and get the gap between them plus the minimum and recommended TPS to get through it.

speed.name: Speed portal
speed.description: Speed the player travels at along the gap axis.

custom-speed.name: Custom speed (units/sec)
custom-speed.description: Overrides the speed portal above when greater than 0. Useful for vertical gaps (ship, UFO, ball, etc.).

player-size.name: Player size
player-size.description: Normal = 30 unit hitbox, Mini = 18 unit hitbox.

axis.name: Gap axis
axis.description: Auto uses the horizontal gap if there is one, otherwise the vertical gap.

ticks.name: Safety ticks inside gap
ticks.description: Recommended TPS guarantees at least this many physics ticks inside the gap.
